jobs.name: roboticsRepoScan
jobs.description: Deep scan of a GitHub robotics repo — capabilities, architecture, integration guide and code examples. Powered by GitHub API + arXiv research.
jobs.requirement: Provide the GitHub repo (owner/repo) you want scanned. Example: {"repo": "huggingface/lerobot"}
jobs.deliverable: Structured report: repo metadata, key modules, integration guide, related papers, recommended use case.

jobs.name: graspPlannerSetup
jobs.description: Design a complete grasp planning pipeline for robotic pick-and-place. Architecture, GQ-CNN config, Dex-Net integration guide and ROS2 node spec.
jobs.requirement: Provide object type and gripper type. Example: {"object": "coffee mug", "gripper": "parallel-jaw"}
jobs.deliverable: Full grasp pipeline: perception stack, grasp sampling config, quality metric, ROS2 node spec, fallback strategy.

jobs.name: navStackSetup
jobs.description: Nav2 autonomous navigation stack configuration for mobile robots. Complete config, launch files, costmap tuning guide and SLAM setup.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot type and environment. Example: {"robot": "differential drive", "environment": "indoor warehouse"}
jobs.deliverable: Nav2 config YAML, costmap params, planner selection, SLAM Toolbox setup, launch sequence.

jobs.name: objectDetectionPipeline
jobs.description: YOLOv8-based real-time object detection pipeline for robot perception. Model selection, inference config, custom training guide and ROS2 integration.
jobs.requirement: Provide target object classes and robot platform. Example: {"classes": ["bottle", "cup"], "platform": "Jetson Orin"}
jobs.deliverable: Model selection guide, ROS2 node spec, custom training command, inference config, fps targets.

jobs.name: segmentationMaskPlan
jobs.description: SAM-based segmentation strategy for robot workspace understanding. Prompt design, mask filtering, downstream integration for grasping or navigation.
jobs.requirement: Provide use case and robot type. Example: {"use_case": "bin picking", "robot": "UR5e"}
jobs.deliverable: SAM prompt design, mask filtering rules, downstream integration spec, latency targets.

jobs.name: diffusionPolicyDesign
jobs.description: Diffusion policy training setup for dexterous manipulation. Dataset format, network architecture, noise scheduler config and training pipeline.
jobs.requirement: Provide manipulation task and number of demos. Example: {"task": "pick and place", "num_demos": 100}
jobs.deliverable: Architecture spec (DDPM/DDIM), dataset format, training config, compute estimate, evaluation protocol.

jobs.name: physicsSimConfig
jobs.description: Genesis or MuJoCo physics simulation configuration for robot task. Scene XML/USD, solver parameters, contact model and rendering setup.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot model and task type. Example: {"robot": "Franka Panda", "task": "drawer opening"}
jobs.deliverable: Scene config file, solver params, contact model settings, rendering config, validation checklist.

jobs.name: gpuSimTraining
jobs.description: Isaac Lab GPU-accelerated robot training workflow. Environment setup, RSL-RL training script, hyperparameter guide and sim-to-real transfer plan.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot type and task. Example: {"robot": "quadruped", "task": "locomotion over terrain"}
jobs.deliverable: IsaacLab env config, training script, hyperparameters, domain randomization guide, GPU hours estimate.

jobs.name: rlEnvDesign
jobs.description: MuJoCo/dm-control RL training environment design. Reward shaping, observation space, action space and curriculum strategy for robot learning.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and observation type. Example: {"task": "reach target", "obs_type": "proprioception+vision"}
jobs.deliverable: Environment spec, reward function design, obs/action space, training algorithm recommendation, step budget.

jobs.name: batchSimStrategy
jobs.description: Brax JAX batched physics simulation strategy for RL. Parallelisation plan, environment vectorisation, training loop design and performance targets.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and target parallel envs. Example: {"task": "hopper", "num_envs": 4096}
jobs.deliverable: Brax env setup, vectorisation config, JAX training loop, wall-clock time estimate, throughput metrics.

jobs.name: embodiedNavPlan
jobs.description: Habitat-Sim embodied navigation task plan. Scene setup, agent config, evaluation metrics, success thresholds and training curriculum.
jobs.requirement: Provide navigation task and scene type. Example: {"task": "object goal navigation", "scene": "apartment"}
jobs.deliverable: Habitat scene config, agent spec, task config, evaluation metrics, training curriculum, baseline comparisons.

jobs.name: openXDataQuery
jobs.description: Query Open X-Embodiment dataset for relevant robot demonstrations. Dataset selection strategy, filtering, preprocessing guide for target task.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot task and embodiment type. Example: {"task": "pick and place", "robot": "UR5"}
jobs.deliverable: Relevant dataset IDs, filtering strategy, preprocessing guide, data quality notes, download instructions.

jobs.name: foundationPolicyEval
jobs.description: Evaluate pi0 (openpi) foundation policy fit for target robot task. Capability assessment, fine-tuning requirements, compute estimate and deployment plan.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot and task. Example: {"robot": "Franka", "task": "coffee cup pick and place"}
jobs.deliverable: Policy fit assessment, fine-tuning guide, demo requirements, compute budget, deployment checklist.

jobs.name: taskMotionPlan
jobs.description: Full PDDL-based task-and-motion plan for manipulation. Predicate design, action templates, motion stream specs and constraint formulation.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and objects involved. Example: {"task": "stack blocks", "objects": ["block_A", "block_B", "table"]}
jobs.deliverable: PDDL domain, problem file, motion stream specs, IK constraints, PDDLStream integration guide.

jobs.name: unitreeDeployPlan
jobs.description: Deployment and motion plan for Unitree Go2 or H1 robot. SDK setup, DDS config, motion primitives, safety constraints and mission strategy.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot model and mission. Example: {"robot": "Go2", "mission": "warehouse inspection patrol"}
jobs.deliverable: SDK setup guide, DDS config, motion primitives list, safety limits, mission plan, failsafe conditions.

jobs.name: moveit2ArmPlan
jobs.description: MoveIt2 arm motion planning configuration. SRDF, kinematics plugin, planning pipeline, collision objects and execution interface setup.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot arm and task. Example: {"arm": "UR10e", "task": "assembly on conveyor"}
jobs.deliverable: SRDF config, kinematics plugin selection, pipeline config, collision objects spec, execution tutorial.

jobs.name: ros2NodeDesign
jobs.description: ROS2 node architecture design for robot system. Topic graph, message types, lifecycle nodes, QoS profiles and package structure.
jobs.requirement: Provide system description and key nodes needed. Example: {"system": "mobile manipulation", "nodes": ["perception", "planning", "control"]}
jobs.deliverable: Node architecture diagram, topic graph, message type list, QoS config, package structure.

jobs.name: droneWaypointPlan
jobs.description: AirSim drone waypoint mission plan. Environment setup, GPS waypoints, sensor config, collision avoidance strategy and flight controller integration.
jobs.requirement: Provide mission type and environment. Example: {"mission": "search and rescue", "environment": "urban outdoor"}
jobs.deliverable: Waypoint list, AirSim config, sensor setup, collision avoidance strategy, FlightController integration.

jobs.name: autoSceneDesign
jobs.description: CARLA autonomous driving scene design. Actor spawning, traffic flow, sensor placement, weather config and scenario evaluation metrics.
jobs.requirement: Provide scenario type and complexity. Example: {"scenario": "intersection crossing", "weather": "rain"}
jobs.deliverable: CARLA Python script, actor spawn config, sensor blueprint, scenario evaluation metrics.

jobs.name: rlPolicyOptimize
jobs.description: Acme distributed RL policy optimization strategy. Actor-learner setup, replay buffer config, policy architecture and convergence targets.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and algorithm preference. Example: {"task": "continuous control", "algorithm": "SAC"}
jobs.deliverable: Acme learner config, actor config, replay buffer settings, network architecture, hyperparameter schedule.

jobs.name: alohaSetupGuide
jobs.description: ALOHA bimanual teleoperation setup guide. Hardware checklist, data collection protocol, ACT policy training pipeline and evaluation metrics.
jobs.requirement: Provide manipulation task. Example: {"task": "fold cloth", "num_demos": 50}
jobs.deliverable: Hardware checklist, teleoperation protocol, dataset format, ACT training config, evaluation metrics.

jobs.name: dexRetargetDesign
jobs.description: Dex-Retargeting pipeline design for robot hand control. Hand pose extraction, retargeting algorithm selection, robot hand joint mapping.
jobs.requirement: Provide input source and robot hand. Example: {"input": "MediaPipe hand tracking", "robot_hand": "LEAP Hand"}
jobs.deliverable: Retargeting algorithm selection, joint mapping table, calibration procedure, latency budget.

jobs.name: mobileRobotSetup
jobs.description: TurtleBot3 ROS2 navigation and perception setup. SLAM config, Nav2 integration, sensor calibration and autonomous patrol routine.
jobs.requirement: Provide environment type and task. Example: {"environment": "office indoor", "task": "autonomous patrol"}
jobs.deliverable: SLAM Toolbox config, Nav2 params, sensor calibration guide, patrol route definition.

jobs.name: stretchArmTask
jobs.description: Hello Robot Stretch mobile manipulation task plan. Reachability analysis, grasp strategy, home navigation integration and safety constraints.
jobs.requirement: Provide target object and location. Example: {"object": "water bottle", "location": "kitchen counter"}
jobs.deliverable: Reachability map, grasp strategy, navigation plan, arm trajectory, safety constraint list.

jobs.name: ikSolverSetup
jobs.description: Pink real-time inverse kinematics configuration for robot arm. Task specification, joint limits, velocity constraints and real-time control loop.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot URDF and task. Example: {"robot": "Franka Panda", "task": "track moving target"}
jobs.deliverable: Pink IK config, task frame spec, joint limit params, velocity bounds, real-time loop code.

jobs.name: torqueCtrlLoop
jobs.description: PyTorch torque control loop design for robot arm. PD controller, impedance control, real-time execution strategy and safety monitoring.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot and control mode. Example: {"robot": "xArm7", "mode": "impedance"}
jobs.deliverable: Controller architecture, PD gains schedule, impedance params, safety cutoff logic, real-time loop.

jobs.name: pointCloudPipeline
jobs.description: PyTorch3D 3D point cloud processing pipeline for robot perception. Filtering, segmentation, object recognition and surface normal estimation.
jobs.requirement: Provide sensor type and application. Example: {"sensor": "RealSense D435", "application": "bin picking"}
jobs.deliverable: Processing pipeline, filtering params, segmentation config, object recognition model, surface estimation.

jobs.name: pointEObjectGen
jobs.description: Point-E 3D object generation strategy for robot task planning. Prompt engineering, mesh export pipeline, collision model generation.
jobs.requirement: Provide object description for generation. Example: {"object": "small red cube with handle"}
jobs.deliverable: Point-E prompt design, mesh export steps, collision model generation, URDF integration guide.

jobs.name: florenceVLRobot
jobs.description: Florence-2 vision-language model integration for robot perception. Prompt design, visual grounding, referring expression comprehension and action grounding.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot task and perception need. Example: {"task": "find and pick mug", "input": "RGB camera"}
jobs.deliverable: Florence-2 prompt templates, grounding config, output parsing, action mapping, latency budget.

jobs.name: humanoidSimPlan
jobs.description: K-Scale humanoid robot simulation training plan. Simulation environment setup, motion library, locomotion policy training and transfer strategy.
jobs.requirement: Provide humanoid model and skill to learn. Example: {"robot": "G1", "skill": "stair climbing"}
jobs.deliverable: Sim environment config, motion library, training curriculum, locomotion policy spec, transfer checklist.

jobs.name: robosuiteEnvSetup
jobs.description: Robosuite manipulation benchmark environment setup. Task selection, robot config, observation space definition and evaluation protocol.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and robot. Example: {"task": "Lift", "robot": "Panda"}
jobs.deliverable: Robosuite config, task spec, obs/action space, eval protocol, baseline performance targets.

jobs.name: hulcLangSkill
jobs.description: HULC2 language-conditioned manipulation skill design. Instruction vocabulary, multi-task training setup, skill chaining and generalisation strategy.
jobs.requirement: Provide skill set and instruction domain. Example: {"skills": ["pick", "place", "push"], "domain": "kitchen objects"}
jobs.deliverable: Instruction vocab, training config, skill chaining spec, evaluation benchmark, generalisation metrics.

jobs.name: rtxPolicyScan
jobs.description: RT-X/RT-2 robotics transformer policy research. Capability scan, supported tasks, fine-tuning requirements and deployment evaluation for target robot.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot and task category. Example: {"robot": "UR5", "task": "table-top manipulation"}
jobs.deliverable: RT-X capability report, supported task list, fine-tuning guide, compute requirements, deployment eval.

jobs.name: pyroboSimTask
jobs.description: PyRoboSim task-level simulation design. World model spec, robot agent config, task planner integration and navigation-manipulation combined workflow.
jobs.requirement: Provide environment and task list. Example: {"environment": "home", "tasks": ["fetch water", "open door"]}
jobs.deliverable: World model YAML, robot config, task planner spec, navigation-manipulation workflow, evaluation.

jobs.name: gibsonHomeSim
jobs.description: iGibson home simulation setup for household robot. Scene loading, object state machine, task specification and VR integration guide.
jobs.requirement: Provide household task and scene. Example: {"task": "tidy room", "scene": "Rs_int"}
jobs.deliverable: iGibson scene config, object state spec, task config, VR integration guide, evaluation metrics.

jobs.name: pinocchioKDyn
jobs.description: Pinocchio kinematics and dynamics analysis for robot. URDF parsing, forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobian computation and dynamics for control.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot URDF and analysis needed. Example: {"robot": "Franka Panda", "analysis": "Jacobian + inverse dynamics"}
jobs.deliverable: Pinocchio model setup, FK/IK functions, Jacobian config, dynamics equations, Python code template.

jobs.name: rlaxPolicyTrain
jobs.description: RLAX JAX RL algorithm component design for robot. Value function, policy gradient, actor-critic architecture and training loop.
jobs.requirement: Provide task and algorithm type. Example: {"task": "reach goal", "algorithm": "actor-critic"}
jobs.deliverable: RLAX component selection, value function design, policy architecture, training loop, JAX code template.

jobs.name: robotLogAnalyze
jobs.description: MCAP robot log analysis and diagnostics. Topic inspection, timestamp analysis, sensor synchronization check and anomaly detection.
jobs.requirement: Provide log topic focus and anomaly type to detect. Example: {"topic": "/joint_states", "detect_anomaly": true}
jobs.deliverable: MCAP analysis report, topic stats, sync analysis, detected anomalies, Foxglove visualization guide.

jobs.name: serlRLFinetune
jobs.description: SERL sample-efficient real-robot RL fine-tuning plan. Reward design, data collection protocol, online learning loop and safety constraint specification.
jobs.requirement: Provide robot, task and safety constraints. Example: {"robot": "Franka", "task": "peg insertion", "max_force": 20}
jobs.deliverable: Reward function design, data collection protocol, online RL loop config, safety watchdog, success metrics.

jobs.name: dexArtGraspPlan
jobs.description: DexArt dexterous articulated object manipulation plan. Object category analysis, multi-finger grasp synthesis, finger trajectory design and force targets.
jobs.requirement: Provide articulated object and dexterous hand. Example: {"object": "scissors", "hand": "LEAP Hand"}
jobs.deliverable: Object analysis, grasp synthesis strategy, finger trajectory, force-torque targets, evaluation protocol.
